note: The Semaphore setup files the registry is sealed against. Nothing here may change: the verification key is baked into the program, and a different proving key produces proofs it will not accept.
ceremony: Semaphore V4 Ceremony, PSE's p0tion, over 400 participants, finished July 13, 2024
library: @semaphore-protocol/* 4.12.1, the last line whose circuit matches these files

semaphore-32.zkey.what: the proving key. Only used to make a proof, on a device. Not committed: 5.8 MB.

semaphore-32.wasm.what: the witness generator. Only used to make a proof, on a device. Not committed: 1.8 MB.

semaphore-32.json.what: the verification key. Converted to ../program/src/verifying_key.rs and sealed into the program.
